name: Loganaar
summary: In Nighthaven, Loganaar guides druids from both factions in the ways of their calling. He teaches them to heed nature and prepares them for the Emerald Dream.

sections.title: Keeper of the Sacred Art
sections.body:
Loganaar welcomes newly initiated druids who come to Moonglade from Darnassus or Thunder Bluff. In Nighthaven, he teaches balance, shape-shifting, and reverence for nature. Even in cold stone or unfamiliar lands, he says, tranquility must come from within. He also leads promising students toward deeper Cenarion Circle concerns.

Some druids he sends to wanderers such as Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater. Others he guides into ancient woodland rites.

sections.title: The Call of the Dream
sections.body: Loganaar teaches that Kalimdor's traditional protectors share a deeper calling: the Emerald Dream. He speaks of the sacred bond between Azeroth's primal spirit realm and the waking world. To master their path, druids must hibernate for centuries and walk among nature's purest forms, guided by the demigods.

faq.answer: Loganaar guides druids in Nighthaven, Moonglade's central settlement. He welcomes druids from every background and introduces them to the Cenarion Circle's deeper traditions.
Yes. Loganaar teaches both tauren and night elf druids. As a member of the Cenarion Circle, he sets aside the conflict between the Alliance and Horde on Moonglade's sacred, neutral ground.

faq.q: What does Loganaar teach about the Emerald Dream?
faq.answer: Loganaar teaches that every true druid feels the Emerald Dream's pull. He says a long, deep hibernation lets druids walk among its uncorrupted forms, where their ultimate training takes place.

faq.q: Where does Loganaar send seasoned druids?
faq.answer: Loganaar sends seasoned druids to observe and mend Azeroth's primal ecosystems. He directs some to help naturalists such as Torwa Pathfinder in the wilderness of Un'Goro Crater.

angles.text: As a druid of Darnassus or Thunder Bluff, you meet Loganaar early after teleporting to Moonglade. He offers advanced training and spiritual counsel.
As a night elf, you share the Kaldorei druids' ancient traditions. For millennia, they communed with nature and entered the Emerald Dream under Malfurion Stormrage.
